Assignment Title: Deposit Interest Calculator

Assignment Question:
Problem Statement
Design an abstract class Account that stores the principal and the number of years, declares one abstract method rate() returning the annual rate of simple interest as a percentage, and provides two concrete methods:
interest() returning (principal × rate × years) / 100.
maturityAmount() returning principal + interest.
Create three subclasses, each of which overrides rate() only:
SavingsAccount — 4 percent per year.
FixedDeposit — 7 percent per year.
RecurringDeposit — 6 percent per year.
Read the account type, the principal and the number of years, then print the interest and the maturity amount.
Input Format
A single line with three tokens separated by spaces.
Token 1: the account type, exactly one of SAVINGS, FIXED or RECURRING.
Token 2: the principal, a real number.
Token 3: the number of years, a whole number.
Output Format
Line 1: Interest = <value>
Line 2: Maturity Amount = <value>
Both values printed with exactly two decimal places.
Constraints
1000.0 ≤ principal ≤ 10000000.0
1 ≤ years ≤ 20
Simple interest only. Compound interest is not used anywhere in this problem.
The account type is always one of the three given words, in capital letters.
Test Cases
Input
	Expected Output
	
SAVINGS 50000 2
	Interest = 4000.00
Maturity Amount = 54000.00
	
SAVINGS 12500 1
	Interest = 500.00
Maturity Amount = 13000.00
